notes_for_editor: Our record matches both sources: name, county, coordinates, tower, gone. Two searches and a few page reads found no build date, staffing, fire history or photos. The Nicolet National Forest history (npshistory.com chapter 3) covers 1932 fire-tower funding at Hiles, Lake Julia and Anvil Lake and does not name Wildcat, so ownership is unknown. The story is short because the sources are thin. Access is unknown.
